five_second.sells: Online courses and a membership for spiritual, meditative drawing practices (the 'Art of Manifesting Method', NeuroGraphica, Neuro Arts) run by one named founder
five_second.for_whom: People into creativity, wellness, and spirituality looking for a calming art/self-development practice, not necessarily artists
five_second.price_guess: Unclear at a glance - guessed somewhere around $100-300 for a course, or a modest monthly membership fee

features_used.moment: Scrolled all the way to the bottom of the homepage first, the way I always do, looking for a contact link or email
Clicked Resources hoping it might be an FAQ or help page, but it was just a list of Amazon affiliate links for drawing supplies
Read the founder's full personal bio hoping a real named person would also mean an easy way to reach her, but found no email or form there either
Opened the legal Privacy Policy as a last resort and found the Data Controller clause listing 'Neuro Art School Ltd' and the email anna@annadenning.com
Read the entire membership page top to bottom, the exact product with the live weekly Zoom sessions my question was about, and it never mentioned a time, day beyond 'Thursday', timezone, or FAQ

features_looked_for_but_missing: A 'Contact' link in the main navigation or footer
An FAQ section answering scheduling/timezone questions for the live sessions
A stated class time or timezone on the membership sales page itself
feature_that_most_helped_the_decision: Finding the real email address (anna@annadenning.com) and the registered UK company name (Neuro Art School Ltd) in the Privacy Policy's Data Controller clause
feature_that_most_hurt_the_decision: No visible Contact page, chat bubble, or FAQ anywhere on the site, including on the membership page that is actually asking for my money

friction.moment: Scrolled the entire homepage footer looking for a contact link and found only Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, and social icons
Checked Resources and About Me pages hoping for a contact form or FAQ; both were content pages with no way to ask a question

Read the full Neuro Arts Membership sales page (well over 10,000 pixels of scrolling) and it never once addressed timezone, exact session time, or gave a FAQ despite being exactly the product I had a question about
Only found a contact email by opening the legal Privacy Policy page - not somewhere a normal shopper would think to look for it

delight.moment: Finding the Data Controller clause confirmed this is a real registered UK company with a real named founder, not an anonymous storefront, which eased some of my skepticism

what_earned_it: Real named founder with a detailed personal bio and photo
Registered UK Ltd company disclosed in the privacy policy
An actual working-looking email address does exist once you find it
trust.what_it_would_take: Put a visible Contact link in the main navigation or footer, add a simple contact form or chat option, and state the email plainly on the About or Membership page instead of burying it in GDPR legal text. A schedule/timezone note on the membership page itself would have answered my question outright.

brand_recall.tell_a_friend_one_sentence: It's one woman's personal online school for meditative 'manifesting' drawing out of the UK, but there's no contact page or chat anywhere - you have to dig into the privacy policy just to find her email.
brand_recall.product_remembered: Neuro Arts Membership - weekly live Zoom drawing sessions
brand_recall.price_remembered: $38 a month, or $375 for the year
